Lemma
[Gromov's short presentation of the fundamental group]

Source: petersen:page-0308, petersen:page-0309 1. ch7:7.2.1A compact Riemannian manifold $M$ admits generators $\{ c_1,\dots ,c_m\} $ for $\Gamma =\pi _1(M)$ such that all relations are of the form $c_ic_jc_k^{-1}=1$ for suitable $i,j,k$, with each generator represented by a loop of length $\le 3\diam (M)$.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch7-gromov-generators \sketch Choose a sufficiently fine triangulation. Loops formed by a basepoint path, one edge, and the reverse basepoint path generate the fundamental group; boundaries of 2-simplices give all relations $c_ic_jc_k^{-1}=1$. Their lengths are at most $2\diam M+\varepsilon \le 3\diam M$.

□
